title: Make Matzah Not War: Easter, Passover, Nowruz, Eleusis & the Spirit of Max
author: Susan Block
content:
![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Pesach-Easter-
Nowruz-680x510.jpg)

Holidays whip up sweet and spicy memories of [Captain
Max](https://drsusanblock.com/max-lobkowicz-filangieri) that I stir into a new
Spring casserole of vintage photos. Like onions, some make me cry, but most
are tasty enough to make me smile and occasionally even lick my lips.

I call it “collage therapy” and, like good holy-dazed comfort food with
special [herbs](https://drsusanblock.com/bunny-420-passover) – such as
*[herb](https://drsusanblock.com/sex-pot),* also celebrated around this time
([4/20](https://drsusanblock.com/pspot-420),
[anyone](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-earth-day)?) – it soothes my [bottomless
sorrow ](https://drsusanblock.com/bottomless-grief) since the [May 13,
2025](https://drsusanblock.com/rip-max) death of my beloved
[husband](https://drsusanblock.com/33rd-wedding-anniversary) [Maximillian R.
Lobkowicz di Filangieri](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/06/20/captain-max-
an-extraordinary-life/), helping me navigate this strange space between grief
and gratitude.

Max Collage #7 highlights the Passover
[Liberation](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/bonobo-liberation-therapy) from
Slavery and the Easter [Resurrection](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-
resurrection%20%E2%80%8E) of Jesus Christ. Filled with [fun and
games](https://drsusanblock.com/bonobo-spring-equinox), Easter
[egg](https://drsusanblock.com/eggs-balls) and Afikoman hunts, these zesty
[Spring holidays](https://drsusanblock.com/bunny-420-passover), can also be
harsh, with [bitter herbs](https://drsusanblock.com/bunny-420-passover#maror)
for [Pesach](https://drsusanblock.com/28th-wedding-anniversary) and fasting
for Lent, to give us a tiny taste of the great suffering of slavery,
crucifixion and other sins perpetrated by human greed, brutality, hubris and
foolishness.

**Liberation & Resurrection**

Both Passover (Pesach in Hebrew) and Easter honor
[divine](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/religious-abuse) Miracles of
[Return](https://drsusanblock.com/the-dtease%20%E2%80%8E), echoing the
primeval [Eleusinian Mysteries](https://drsusanblock.com/31st-wedding-
anniversary#Persephone) of [spring](https://drsusanblock.com/springing-max2),
which celebrate the pagan return of Persephone, Princess of the Underworld –
and queen of the funereal
[grief](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/09/05/bottomless-grief-topless-
cake/) I now feel – to her own grieving Earth Mother Demeter.

Yes, long before the Rebirth of the [Holy
Son](https://drsusanblock.com/springtime-for-sex-and-god2#Jesus) returning to
His Father in Heaven, the ancients honored the Resurrection of the Holy
Daughter returning to Her Mother on Earth.

According to the Greeks, the Goddess Persephone (Proserpina to the Romans –
like Max) rises up from the bowels of Hades (Pluto) to the old Athenian suburb
of [Eleusis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elefsina), rejoining Her Earth Mama
Demeter (Ceres) who is so ecstatic to embrace the fruit of Her loins that She
showers the world in spring (now that’s some serious
[squirting](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/squirting-world))!

I only wish Max could return to me as Persephone returns to Her Earth Mother
Demeter and Jesus returns to His Heavenly Father. That utterly irrational yet
profound longing for the return of my beloved has opened my agnostic heart to
understanding the deep faith so many place in the miracle of resurrection.

Ahhhh… if only!

**Miracles of Spring**

Though pretty amazing, the stories of [Purim and St. Paddy’s
Day](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-purim) don’t feature scientifically
impossible *miracles.* No miraculous parting of the sea, and no walking on it
either. The [Megillat Esther](https://drsusanblock.com/purim) doesn’t even
mention the name of God. Easter and Passover are all about God and His (in
Judeo-Christian-Islamic lore, God’s pronouns are always “He/Him”) miracles.
Things that *can’t* happen – manna from heaven, resurrection of the dead – do.

The closest thing to a miracle I’ve ever experienced was Max himself, his
energy and his love that somehow – miraculously – both protected and
[liberated](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/bonobo-liberation-therapy) me.
Though agnostic, we tried to honor all the Gods and Goddesses, because as Max
would say with a wink, “You never know.” We were fascinated and sometimes
aroused by the ancient tales. Our _[Commedia
Erotica](https://drsusanblock.tv/)_ interpretations might be considered
[blasphemous](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/religious-abuse), but they
were always heartfelt.

On the Passover/Easter convergence of 2011, we held a big “[Last Supper
Seder](https://drsusanblock.com/last-supper-seder),” sharing matzah and
chocolate bunnies, colored eggs, the Pascal lamb, red wine, “[bitter
herbs](https://drsusanblock.com/28th-wedding-anniversary#maror)” and [4/20
herbs](https://drsusanblock.com/bunny-420-passover) with professors, porn
stars, artists and therapists. Max had just recovered from [bladder cancer
surgery](https://drsusanblock.com/captain-max-big-c-battle) a couple of weeks
before, and he wasn’t sure if he was well enough to attend. But as I began the
seder, he slipped into a long robe and suddenly *appeared* from behind my
chair, [playing](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/erotic-theater) the part of
the resurrected Jesus… or [Elijah](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-
passover#Elijah), depending on what you believe. It was mystical, hilarious
and genuinely surprised me – almost like a real resurrection!

I keep hoping he’ll do that again…

**Easter, Pesach, Nowruz**

Though we weren’t religious believers, Max fervently believed in consuming all
the delicious foods of our elaborate Passover/Easter seder dinners, from
matzah ball soup to chocolate Easter bunnies. Both Pesach and Easter highlight
[eggs](https://drsusanblock.com/eggs-balls), which Max adored, regardless of
color.

Iranian or Persian New Year, aka “Nowruz,” also features eggs, sweets, spring
cleaning, the idea of rebirth, renewal, sometimes rebellion (how about those
Arab Springs?) and other parallels to the spring holidays Max and I grew up
on. A 3000-year-old [Vernal Equinox](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-spring-
fever) festival that’s more cultural than religious, with roots in
[Zoroastrianiasm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoroastrianism), and is
observed by over 300 million people around the world, we’d often acknowledge
Nowruz or Noorooz (meaning “New Day”) in our
[Bonoboville](https://drsusanblock.com/bonoboville) Spring holiday bacchanals,
but admittedly without nearly as much detail as Pesach or Easter because being
the dumb Judeo-Christian-Pagan-Agnostics we are, we really didn’t know Nowruz
from Babaghanoush (which is actually Lebanese, not Iranian).

At least we acknowledged our ignorance, unlike many raised in so-called
“Judeo-Christian” culture who excuse their war crimes by framing Iran as a
savage society or Islam as an especially vicious religion.

**Bonoboville Spring Bacchanals**

Of course, Nowruz, Pesach and Easter are family occasions, but there comes a
time when anyone with a pulse tires of trying to please their aunties and in-
laws and craves a spicier blessing. Time to catch [Spring
Fever](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-spring-fever) and fall in love… or at
least [party like a bonobo](https://drsusanblock.com/wp-
content/uploads/2014/11/PartyLikeABonobo.jpg)!

Thus, for the past three decades, after spending the first part of their
holiday with family, bevies of Easter Bunnies, Passover
[Kink](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/kink)sters and a few Nowruz revelers
would gather together in the Womb Room Sanctuary at the little Love Church of
[The Bonobo Way](https://www.amazon.com/Bonobo-Way-Evolution-Through-
Pleasure/dp/0692323767/) in Dr. Suzy’s
[Speakeasy](https://drsusanblock.com/speakeasy) of
[Bonoboville](https://drsusanblock.com/bonoboville) to celebrate the erotic,
not-so family-friendly, bacchanalian roots of the [Judeo-
Christian](http://archive.drsusanblock.com/editorial/religion2.htm) Rites of
Spring. And no, it wasn’t a cult; we were just having irreverent consenting-
adult holiday fun.

Officiating in my priestly robes, tallit, gold cross (a gift from a devout
Catholic therapy client), Star of David (woven for me by [Twin
Towers](http://drsusanblock.com/speakeasy-seder%20%E2%80%8E) inmates from the
threads of their prison uniforms), “Lox et Veritas”
[g-string](http://drsusanblockinstitute.com/panties) and bunny ears, I would
channel the spirit of The Great [Bonobo
Spring](https://drsusanblock.com/bonobo-spring) Easter Bunny Matzah Goddess,
or some such mirthful divinity.

And [Capt’n Max](https://drsusanblock.com/max-lobkowicz-filangieri) would
channel [Capt’n Max](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/06/20/captain-max-an-
extraordinary-life/). Sometimes he’d wear his own Twin-Towers-woven star or
bunny ears, but his sheer presence always projected plenty of divine “main
character energy” on its own.

**Never Again for Anyone**

The [pandemic](https://drsusanblock.com/coronavirus-spring) cooled down our
[bacchanals](https://drsusanblock.com/bonboville-reunion), and as Israel’s
escalating attacks on Palestinians passed over [Passover
2021](https://www.counterpunch.org/2021/05/21/shemah-yisrael/), Max and I
sadly stowed our Stars of David, put on Keffiyehs and raised [Palestinian
flags](https://www.counterpunch.org/2024/05/17/reply-to-a-zionist-troll/). At
the time, the choice felt simple to us: “Never Again” meant “Never Again for
Anyone.”

Yet nothing is ever that simple. With loved ones on all sides, we couldn’t
fully root for any *side* except the [Bonobo Way](https://bonoboway.com/), the
side of peace through pleasure,
[ceasefire](https://www.counterpunch.org/2024/05/17/reply-to-a-zionist-
troll/), sharing and good old-fashioned diplomacy. We also continued to root
for [Freedom of Speech](https://drsusanblock.com/max-to-the-maximus) – a vital
aspect of that “freedom” from slavery that Passover celebrates – and that’s
free speech for everyone, including the
[creeps](https://drsusanblock.com/active-radio-6) who try to take ours away.

With Max now gone, I still root for [free
speech](https://drsusanblock.com/free-speech-woman) and the [Bonobo
Way](https://www.amazon.com/Bonobo-Way-Evolution-Through-
Pleasure/dp/0692323767/), but I miss our painted eggs on the Last Supper seder
plate. I miss Max.

**Make Matzah Not War**

Max [passed over](https://drsusanblock.com/rip-max) (literally) before
[tRump](https://drsusanblock.com/tag/trump)’s current bombardment of the
ancient land of [Iran](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/03/06/catastrophe-in-
the-gulf-trumps-war-on-iran/), aka [Operation Epstein
Folly](https://x.com/drsuzy/status/2027799963221299535). Yes, “Operation Epic
Fury” (did a gamer come up with that name?) was re-christened “Operation
Epstein Fury” by clickbait influencers, but that merely exchanges
[Epstein](https://drsusanblock.com/active-radio-6) for “Epic,” and it’s much
worse than that.

“Folly” is more on-the-nose than “Fury” because none of the architects of this
mess are authentically “furious” about anything. Certainly, the babbling
[tRumpus](https://drsusanblock.com/tag/trump) is not furious, nor are any of
his [cosplaying](https://drsusanblock.com/kink-month-cosplay)
[Cabinet](https://www.whitehouse.gov/administration/the-cabinet/) of [Dr.
Caligari](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IP0KB2XC29o) horror actors, yes-
models and real estate developers. But they are all remarkably, hubristically
and rather dangerously foolish.

The bombing of the [girls’
school](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/03/16/when-hegseth-says-lethality-
hes-talking-about-killing-iranian-school-girls/) might be Herr Trumpenstein’s
most foolish and horrific deed yet, especially as it appears to be a bloody
coda to his [Epstein](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/02/20/the-state-of-
sexual-union-2026/) history.

Fools can be funny, but this fool’s errand is devastating to people all over
the Middle East. Needless to say, [Nowruz
2026](https://www.iranintl.com/en/202603168540) is not as joyous as usual,
though some Iranians are observing the pre-Nowruz traditional fire ritual
[Chaharshanbe Suri](https://www.euronews.com/2026/03/18/iranians-celebrate-
ancient-fire-festival-as-security-forces-disrupt-event-in-tehran) by defying
government orders, while others are
[burning](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/16/iran-officials-tout-trump-
burning-celebration-amid-battle-of-narratives) effigies of tRump and Bibi.

Poor [Trumpty Dumpty](https://www.counterpunch.org/2020/11/13/trumpty-dumpty-
falls/) was “[shocked](https://www.thedailybeast.com/trump-makes-bombshell-
confession-he-was-shocked-at-middle-east-war-escalation/)” that a big
*civilized* country like Iran would actually fight back when pelted with
American bombs. “They weren’t supposed to,”
[Trumpty](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/03/18/the-end-of-childhood/)
whined (not so subtly blaming [Jared](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-trump-
nukes)), as Dr. Caligari’s Cabinet of Creeps nodded along, bombing away
anyway.

Where’s [Moses](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parting_of_the_Red_Sea) to part
the [Strait of Hormuz](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/17/us/politics/trump-
nato-iran-strait-of-hormuz.html) with his magic [God
Rod](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parting_of_the_Red_Sea) when you need him?

If Max were alive, no doubt he’d be ranting against these mad, arrogant,
avaricious fools. And he’d make it personal, telling the story of his own
experience as a former starry-eyed [U.S. Army
recruit](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-family) to any bewildered
soldiers that might be listening. Max was a rifleman, a crack shot being
groomed for sniper duty when one fine day, his young brain figured out that
after target practice came killing his fellow humans. So, he threw down his
rifle, picked up a pen and studied war no more.

Well, it wasn’t that simple (nothing ever is), but that’s a story for another
[collage](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-family). In the meantime, let’s
simply end this foolish war, or whatever it’s called.

Max would say, “Listen Trumpty, we all know you’re a bully and a fool, so why
not go TACO (Trump Always Chickens Out), find an offramp (but that
[doesn’t](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/03/17/cuba-will-survive-a-diary/)
mean pivoting to “[take Cuba](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/16/cuba-trump-
taking.html)”!), and stop the bombing? Then _maybe_ they’ll stop _their_
bombing (after all, you started it), and [we can
all](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/01/01/go-bonobos-in-2026/) [go
bonobos](https://drsusanblock.com/go-bonobos-2026), eat chocolate eggs and
enjoy the miracles of Spring.”

Not that it’s ever that simple, but in the meantime… Happy Easter, Passover,
Nowruz, 4/20, [Dionysia](http://drsusanblock.com/bonobo-spring),
[Primavera](https://drsusanblock.com/easter-eve-primavera), Eleusinian
Mysteries, Spring Break or whatever you celebrate, from me,
[Bonoboville](https://drsusanblock.com/bonoboville) and the Spirit of
[Max](https://drsusanblock.com/max-lobkowicz-filangieri).
